title: apphub.googleapis.com/AgentProperties
description: The schema for apphub.googleapis.com/AgentProperties. Except for framework, the properties are derived from the A2A Agent Card.

displayName.description: The display name of the agent.

version.description: Contains the version of the Agent.

framework.description: The agent framework used to develop the agent.

agentCardUri.description: The URI of the agent card for the agent.

skills.description: A list of skills the agent possesses.

items.title: Skills
items.description: Defines a skill for an agent.

id.description: A unique identifier for the agent's skill.

name.description: A human readable name for the agent's skill.

description.description: A description of the agent's skill.

tags.description: A set of keywords describing the skill's capabilities.

examples.description: Example prompts or scenarios that this skill can handle.
